full_judgment: 8. It appears from the judgment of the appellate Court and evidence of PWs 1, 2 and 3 that the plaintiffs admitted that the defendants have been possessing the suit land and there is a dwelling homestead of defendant No. 3 in the suit land. PW 4 in his cross-examination admitted that the defendant No. 3 exavated a pond in the suit land. Accordingly, the appellate Court held that the instant suit for simple declaration without the prayer for recovery of khas possession was not maintainable.
